decisions.reason: Locates the apiProxy inject and the ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers call in index.js, maps them to breaking card A1-01, explains the host-plane migration to injecting llm and calling listProviders (plus the configurable split), and flags the removed apiproxy dependency in package.json. Applying RemoteResult branching to a host-plane domain call is questionable but secondary.

Gives each of the other six categories a no-hit verdict with the patterns searched and full-read evidence; treats session-notes.js as pure utilities and classifies cordis.patch.yml as ordinary composition, not a source patch, without inventing coupling.

Explains that the scan is heuristic and card coverage curated, that dependency, packaging and runtime facts sit outside the seven classes, and that the decisive apiProxy break shows six zero-hit categories do not establish compatibility.

Proposes build (notes typecheck N/A unless types are added), an isolated-profile cold boot with no pending rows, and a real provider-list call covering success and failure, all framed as post-migration steps not yet run.
